A collection of useful bits and pieces I have put together while solving real problems, exploring ideas and finding better ways to get everyday work done.

Practical tools worth sharing

Not every useful piece of software needs to become a complete platform domain or a large standalone product. This part of the site is where I collect smaller tools, experiments and utilities that are useful in their own right and might be of interest to other developers, technical teams or curious visitors.

Some solve a specific problem, some demonstrate an approach and others simply make a repetitive task easier. They are shared here in the hope that they save someone time, provide a useful starting point or spark an idea of their own.
